notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); fund balances 10,725,929 -> 9,933,058 reconcile with debt proceeds 2,500,000 and gross transfers 386,600 in / 386,600 out (net 0). Beginning cash not printed (only beginning fund balance); ending_cash = governmental funds Total assets (all cash lines, p3). Business-type receipts/disbursements and balances from the accrual proprietary statement (p6 Total column, same basis as FY2024 and the utility detail): beginning net position 13,917,897 + 2,676,231 - 1,665,996 = ending 14,928,132; nonoperating gain and interest income as receipts, interest expense as a disbursement. Proprietary cash flows left null (modified cash basis report, as FY2024). Charges for services split by fund column as FY2024: Lottery Fund 2,396,337 keno/lottery, other funds 616,055. Taxes 3,977,664 split by fund name: City Sales Tax column 828,698 -> sales tax, remainder 3,148,966 stays taxes (the Statement of Activities breakdown plus TIF 665,765 adds to 3,977,665, $1 off, so not used). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (p3, totals equal the government-wide column), business-type from the modified cash Statement of Net Position (p1), totals from p1 Total column.
